summary: Keep GitHub observation progressing when individual watched nodes are no longer available

schema.detail: Repository observer cursors gain an optional repository-scoped tombstone set, retained in replicated cursors. Existing cursors default to an empty set. No client-v0 schema or generated output changes.

rules.detail: Only NOT_FOUND errors whose path identifies a requested null nodes() entry are terminal for that identity. The observer records state=closed with state_reason=not_found and removes the identity from its watch set, while processing healthy nodes. Other errors, including mixed failures, still fail the observation.

compatibility.detail: Stale discovery listings cannot re-add tombstoned identities, including after observer takeover. Tombstones are scoped to the original repository: a transferred issue discovered in its destination repository is observed normally, even with the same node ID. An unavailable original subject has no inferred transfer target; transfers that still resolve retain existing moved_to behavior.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Older binaries ignore the added cursor field and may rediscover unavailable identities; no data migration is required.
